paragraphs.text: Nicanor Abundis Fregoso participated in Shipment LZC-10-05 on 2010-09-13. Bruma del Cobre was linked to Shipment LZC-10-05 on 2010-09-13. Shipment LZC-10-05 occurred at Lázaro Cárdenas on 2010-09-13. A dock supervisor at Lázaro Cárdenas with direct access to the airstrip south of the port reported that Abundis, the recruit known as El Zanate, supervised the loading of 35 kg of cocaine onto a light aircraft bound for a strip in Sonora and onward by road to Los Angeles. The supervisor described the aircraft as the small twin-engine plane the crews call Avioneta Nube Gris.

Nicanor Abundis Fregoso used DEMO-TEL-00149 on 2010-09-13. Shipment LZC-10-05 transited Lázaro Cárdenas port plaza on 2010-09-13. Bruma del Cobre controlled Lázaro Cárdenas port plaza from 2010-03-14 until 2012-07-09. The supervisor stated that Abundis coordinated the arrival of the aircraft using the telephone identifier above and that the strip is inside the area the network controls through the port. The supervisor characterized the use of aircraft for small loads as new for the network, which had previously moved product by truck and vessel.

Rogelio Anzures Tapia led Bruma del Cobre from 2010-03-14 until 2014-08-02. The supervisor described Anzures as the person who authorized the use of the aircraft and stated that the pilot was a former agricultural sprayer from Colima. The reporting office assesses the supervisor as reliable and as having direct access to the airstrip. The quantity reported here is the source's estimate and has not been weighed by the reporting office. The supervisor added that the pilot was paid in cash by Abundis on the strip and that the aircraft returned the same evening with no cargo. The supervisor has no information on where the load was transferred to road transport in Sonora.
